rites.name: Valastus
rites.text: Valastus is the concept of the root-bond, the pull by which seedlings find each other underground and knit the first groves of Voraikun together during the Singing. In the Age of the first sovereign it is said to be the force that let growing kingdoms hold their borders against drought and flood.

rites.name: Thardeld
rites.text: Thardeld is a concept of Voraikun's Seeding, the moment the makers plant the Weave and let quiet powers lie dormant in the land. It is remembered in the temples of the Holy Age as the idea that heat and flame can be bound to a single purpose.

rites.name: Elionnys
rites.text: Elionnys is the concept of a shelving rite in Voraikun's Grounded Realm, practiced during the E7 Era when the ending branches into three futures. Its practitioners sort each possible outcome onto the Library's shelves so that none is lost, a quiet labor that keeps the branches legible to the people who must choose among them.
